🔥 The fire settles. Valeria has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Nevermore — I put it down today." "Its shadow detaches from the branch-shadow and slides across the ground toward you — a straight black lane, growing. The bird hasn't moved. The shadow has." "It climbs, laughing in a dead voice — out of spear reach, watching." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Victor breathes "So it bleeds." Ella asks "The fire feels smaller now." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"
